Messages.Author: ilmale
Messages.Body:
Hi Richard, I'm the Italian NC. We are working at the web site and it will be on line soon. Probably in the second week of june. I can provide some more information:

DATES
Welcome Party: Thursday Night november 10th
Tournaments: from Friday november 11th till Sunday november 13th

ACCOMODATION:
We have a special formula reserved for all tournaments players at the hotel Columbus Sea which is very close to the venue: www.columbussea.com/
The prices reserved for us are:

Single bedroom with breakfast included € 65,00 per night
Twin or Double bedroom with breakfast € 80,00 per night
Triple bedroom with breakfast € 90,00 per night

Plus € 2 per night for each person for daily tourist tax.

When you write to book your stay, use this address:
and please report this sentence in the subject of your email: vampiregenova2016

EC Entry Fee
Three days pass plus welcome party: € 45
Single day: € 15
Welcome party only: €10 with typical Italian food.

The venue is within walking distance and we could stay there until late night.
I hope this will provide some information, stay assured that soon you will find us online properly
If anyone is in need of some clarification, please drop me a private message here.
Thanks!

"When you are an anvil, wait.
When you are an hammer, strike."
Italian NC

Messages.Author: Squidalot
Messages.Body:
you need to announce deck lists on the event page otherwise everything needed is in 1.2 of tournament rules, so i'm assuming no.

1.2. Necessary Tournament Materials

Players must bring the following items to a tournament in order to participate:

A visible and reliable method to maintain and record game information (counters for the Blood Bank, pen and paper to record deck information if required, and so on).
A valid and unique V:EKN number registered in the participant's name.
Note: New players must register for V:EKN membership at their first tournament. Players may only have one V:EKN number. Tournament organizers must report any player using more than one V:EKN membership number.
Any materials specifically required for a particular tournament format, as required by the V:EKN Floor Rules or the tournament organizer.
Example: Players need to bring their assembled decks to Constructed tournaments.

Messages.Author: ilmale
Messages.Body:
Here we are. The EC 2016 is so close now! Many players from all over Europe already gathered in Genoa and are waiting for the hell to unleash. Just few tips and last details: it's cold and windy in Genoa, so dress accordingly (this won't apply for finnish and swedish players). The venue is in Piazzale San Benigno, no number given since it is the only building in the square. The registrations are open from Thursday evening. Friday morning registration open at 9.00 o' clock, so please show on time. Tournaments starts at 10.00.
Vekn PDF cards in your decks need to be printed in color on standard paper, matte sleeves. Please bring your decklist with you. We are looking forward to welcome you in Genoa! Don't miss it.
